title: Left adjoint-transpose calculation for proper open coefficient restriction
statement:
Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p_0>0$, let $\ell\ne p_0$ be prime, and let $Z,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $p:Z\to Y$ be proper, $v:V\hookrightarrow Y$ open, and put $Z_V=Z\times_YV$, with projections $u:Z_V\hookrightarrow Z$ and $q:Z_V\to V$. Let $\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be any listed coefficient map of [det-prop-scalar-six-direct-image], with its condensed and finite-subextension conventions. On ordinary unbounded module derived categories [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] put $T_S=\Lambda'_S\otimes^L_{\Lambda_S}-$ [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-change], and let $M\in\Dctf(Z,\Lambda)$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Write $L_f=f_\Lambda^*$, $R_f=Rf_{*,\Lambda}$, $L'_f=f_{\Lambda'}^*$, $R'_f=Rf_{*,\Lambda'}$, with units $\eta_f,\eta'_f$ and counits $\epsilon_f,\epsilon'_f$. Let $c_f:L'_fT_{\mathrm{target}(f)}\xrightarrow{\sim}T_{\mathrm{source}(f)}L_f$ be the inverse canonical pullback comparison [det-prop-scalar-six-pullback](1), and let $a:L_qL_v\xrightarrow{\sim}L_uL_p$ and $a':L'_qL'_v\xrightarrow{\sim}L'_uL'_p$ be the canonical composition comparisons for $pu=vq$. Define $\gamma_{f,N}$ to be the $L'_f\dashv R'_f$ adjunct of $T(\epsilon_{f,N})\circ c_{f,R_fN}$, as in [det-prop-scalar-six-direct-image]. For either coefficient ring define $b_{p,N}$ to be the $L_q\dashv R_q$ adjunct of $L_u(\epsilon_{p,N})\circ a_{R_pN}$, using primed functors for $\Lambda'$. Put $P=R_pM$, $t=L_u(\epsilon_{p,M})\circ a_P$, and define the inverse transpose over $\Lambda'$ by $\tau(h)=\epsilon'_{q,T_{Z_V}L_uM}\circ L'_q(h)$. All compositions below are read right to left.

The morphism
$$h_L=R'_q(c_{u,M})\circ b^{\Lambda'}_{p,T_ZM}\circ L'_v(\gamma_{p,M})\circ c_{v,P}^{-1}:T_VL_vP\longrightarrow R'_qT_{Z_V}L_uM$$
has inverse transpose
$$\tau(h_L)=c_{u,M}\circ L'_u(\epsilon'_{p,T_ZM})\circ L'_uL'_p(\gamma_{p,M})\circ a'_{T_YP}\circ L'_q(c_{v,P}^{-1})=T_{Z_V}(t)\circ c_{q,L_vP}.$$
In particular the coherent pullback comparisons satisfy
$$c_{u,L_pP}\circ L'_u(c_{p,P})\circ a'_{T_YP}\circ L'_q(c_{v,P}^{-1})=T_{Z_V}(a_P)\circ c_{q,L_vP}.$$
These equalities do not assume that either exchange map or $\gamma$ is invertible.
